label: DB 6 × 3
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: The stance the label names is verified by direct count, not inference: 6 buttons in 2 columns of 3, double-breasted wrap, 3 fastening positions = DB 6 x 3. It is not the neighbouring 6x2 (which would leave the top pair unfastened with buttons spaced differently), nor an 8-button configuration - I can see exactly three pairs and no fourth. The wrap depth and parallel rows match 'the traditional balanced DB configuration that fastens through most of the front' with 'straight button rows'. The square front hem also matches the owner's correction note 'square front bottom'.
